name: Super Mario Kart™
description:
Start your engines for the original, legendary Super Mario Kart; which spawned a series that is still going strong today.
Choose from eight Mushroom Kingdom characters – from familiar faces like Mario and Bowser, to Donkey Kong Jr. in his only karting appearance. Burn rubber across classic courses like Mario Circuit, Bowser Castle, Koopa Beach and the infamous Rainbow Road!

This is the US version of the game.
disclaimer:
You may need to upgrade your current SD Card to a compatible SDHC Card or microSDHC Card with enough available space to download this software. Visit support.nintendo.com for information about storage options. Sold separately.

Some features from the original game are not available in this version of the game.
